note: Source of truth for the source watch list. Validated and rendered by scripts/source_impact.py; docs/maintenance/source-watch-list.md is generated from this file. A source is something the kit's content relies on: a law, standard, criteria set, regulator guidance or tool. Owners are roles, not names.

sources.name: General Data Protection Regulation
sources.url_status: Fetched on 2026-10-09 (Publications Office edition, English). EUR-Lex itself returned an empty bot-challenge page.
sources.checked_what: Articles 3, 4(7), 4(8), 4(12), 5, 12(3), 24, 25, 27, 28, 30, 32, 33, 34, 35 and 36(1) read in full or in the relevant paragraphs; Chapter V (Articles 44 to 49) read in full on 2026-10-12; titles of Articles 12 to 23 and 50 only.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and on any announced amendment
sources.notes: Articles 15 to 22 beyond titles have not been read. Article 47 (binding corporate rules) and Article 50 were not relied on in detail.

sources.name: Commission standard contractual clauses for transfers to third countries
sources.checked_what: Articles 1 to 4 of the Decision; the four module titles; Clauses 7 (docking), 8.7 and 8.8 (onward transfers), 9 (sub-processor options), 14 (local laws and practices, paragraphs (a) to (f)) and the title of Annex III.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and when the Commission amends or replaces the clauses
sources.notes: Other clauses (liability, supervision, termination, governing law) were not read. Clause numbers cited are those of Modules One to Three as read; Module Four was not relied on beyond its title.

sources.name: EDPB Recommendations 01/2020 on measures that supplement transfer tools
sources.url_status: Publication page fetched on 2026-10-12. The PDF was not downloaded.
sources.checked_what: Title, document type and date (18 June 2021, final version) on the publication page only. The recommendations themselves were not read.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and when the EDPB publishes an update
sources.notes: The transfer template names supplementary measures using the wording of Clause 14(b)(iii) of the standard clauses, not this document. Reading it is a pending citation.

sources.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act
sources.checked_what: Articles 2, 3, 4, 28(1) to (3), 30(1) to (4), 31(1), (2), (11) to (13) and 33(1) read; Articles 5, 6, 9 to 12 and 17 to 19 read in part.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and on any announced amendment
sources.notes: Technical standards that the Regulation asks the European Supervisory Authorities to develop (for example under Article 30(5)) are not tracked yet.

sources.name: AICPA Trust Services Criteria
sources.edition_mapped: 2017 Trust Services Criteria (With Revised Points of Focus - 2022)
sources.url_status: Publisher page fetched on 2026-10-09. The criteria document needs a free account and was not downloaded.
sources.checked_what: Publication title and date (30 September 2023) only. The criteria themselves were not read.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and when a new edition or points of focus are published
sources.notes: Every SOC 2 mapping record is needs expert review until the criteria are checked.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 27001 information security management systems
sources.url_status: Not found: the ISO site returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on 2026-10-09. Find and verify the standard's page manually.
sources.checked_what: Nothing. The standard is paid and could not be read.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and when an amendment or corrigendum is published
sources.notes: Every ISO mapping record is needs expert review. Amendments and corrigenda have not been checked.

sources.name: NIS2 Directive
sources.checked_what: Articles 1, 2, 3, 6 (definitions of cloud computing service, managed service provider and managed security service provider), 21(1) to (3), 26, 27(1) and (2), 41(1) and the title of Article 44; Annexes I and II (sector lists) read in full.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and on any announced amendment
sources.notes: Used for screening only; the kit does not assess NIS2 compliance. Articles 4 to 5, 7 to 20, 22 to 25, 28 onwards (other than those listed) were not read. National transposition is not tracked: the worksheet makes each user record the national law, its status and the date checked. Guidance from the Commission and ENISA and the Art. 21(5) implementing acts were not read.

sources.name: Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC concerning the definition of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises
sources.url_status: Fetched on 2026-10-12 (Publications Office PDF, English). It is a recommendation, not binding law; NIS2 Art. 2(1) makes its Annex the size test.
sources.checked_what: Annex Articles 2 and 3 (ceilings, partner and linked enterprises, Art. 3(4)) and the titles of Articles 4 to 6.
sources.review_cadence: At least yearly, and when the Commission revises the definition
sources.notes: Articles 4 to 6 (data, reference period, staff headcount rules) were not read. Cited only as the size test referred to by NIS2 Art. 2(1).
